mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and 41 degree temperatures near the Military Ridge State Trail, with a waning crescent moon overhead. Tonight will bring a low of 32 degrees with no rain predicted.

Public works announced pavement repairs will take place November 10 and 11, which will impact parking on several streets including Morningside Boulevard and Mozart Street. Additionally, the Plan Commission is meeting on December 7 to discuss development projects, including a site plan for Sub-Zero.
Enjoy live music today at Bailey's Run. Tomorrow, you can catch more music at Lake Lou-ee and Paddy Mac's, or visit the Dane County Farmers' Market at the Square.
In recent police activity, officers arrested a man for an O W I on October 25 after he was discovered passed out in his vehicle at an intersection.
Stop by for a scoop of the Chocolate Volcano flavor of the day. The Verona location is open and serving guests until 10:30 PM tonight.
